clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle, Incendia Agave grows in the Boiling Pool. A skilled shaman can enchant it to kindle the sacred fire of life.

In Thousand Needles, Incendia Agave grows in and around the waters of the Boiling Pool, beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle. Wandering steam elementals guard the scarce plant, making it difficult to harvest. Though it grows underwater, the plant holds natural elements suited to rituals of flame.
